name: Ranger Guile of the Ranger: Instinct adds 20% of Agility as critical strike rating (#1371)
contract: Guile of the Ranger 520353 reads 'Your Instinct now additionally increases your critical strike rating by $s1% of your Agility.' ($s1 = BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20). Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on 520545, a 15 sec (DurationIndex 8) self aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT with MiscValue 1792 (CR_CRIT_MELEE, CR_CRIT_RANGED, CR_CRIT_SPELL) and MiscValueB 1 (Agility), BasePoints 19 (+20%). Instinct 801434 (SpellFamilyName 27, SpellFamilyFlags (16,0,0), DmgClass 2) also lasts 15 sec. Spell.dbc gives 520353 ProcFlags 0; the spell_proc row from rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql (ProcFlags 16, family 27 mask0 16, phase HIT) is what lets it fire. Expected: casting Instinct without the talent grants no 520545 and leaves the ratings alone; with the talent each Instinct grants 520545 for up to 15 sec and raises the melee, ranged and spell critical strike ratings by floor(20% of current Agility), so each rating delta divided by Agility is in [0.19, 0.201] for any plausible level-80 Agility.

steps.label: Control Instinct without Guile of the Ranger
